market.question: Will the highest temperature in Atlanta be between 74-75°F on April 30?

assessment.reasoning: NWS forecast for Atlanta Thursday Apr 30 calls for a high near 65°F with showers, well below the 74-75°F bucket. Difference of ~10°F vs forecast makes the specific 1°F bucket very unlikely.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Forecast bust to the warm side if showers fail to materialize and skies clear.
